revision_binding.policy: Populate from actual replay; do not self-reference a future commit.

mathematical_claim.space: Real functions on a finite state set X
mathematical_claim.projector: P_Pi is the block-average orthogonal projector
mathematical_claim.graph: H_Pi has one vertex per partition block; join pairs of target blocks hit from a common source block; retain isolated vertices
mathematical_claim.components: c(H_Pi) counts all components including isolated vertices

domain_verified.note: Historical mutations.py covered graph-level alternatives only; new D-level alternatives require fresh execution.

mutant_cluster_note: R:c-only-variant currently duplicates R:c and is reported INVALID_MUTANT until a mathematically distinct definition is supplied. The ignore-isolated/preimage relationship remains bounded to observed cases.

witness_suite.scope_note: Historical witness declarations are not evidence that the revised implementation has been replayed.

repro.environment: Recorded by actual replay; not prefilled
repro.hashes: Generated from actual tested source files
repro.historical_workflow_claim: The documented .github/workflows/sm003-verify.yml was absent at the audited commit; not treated as current evidence.

evidence_class: SOURCE_AUDIT_REQUIRED; new mutation results pending replay

evidence_policy.V: Reproducible bounded computation with retained output and revision binding
evidence_policy.L: Lean proof accepted only after build with no sorry in the claimed dependency closure
evidence_policy.C: Independent clean-checkout replay with complete provenance
evidence_policy.F: Frozen only when the claim registry records the frozen revision and evidence

mutation_policy.rule: Every declared alternative has an explicit implementation and outcome; aliases do not count as distinct coverage.
mutation_policy.prohibition: Do not report coverage for alternatives not executed.

required_checks: independent graph-oracle versus exact matrix-rank comparison
source-block image must include every target block hit by T
record stdout, stderr, exit status, runtime, interpreter and dependency versions
record source and fixture SHA-256 hashes
bind outputs to the committed revision
